title.narrative: Plan to develop a model for eco-restoration and sustainable development in National Capital Region

description.narrative:
The objective of the programme is to develop a comprehensive eco-restoration plan in a pilot area, aimed at restoring biodiversity and water balance to enhance quality of life and promote sustainable urban development. This will be achieved by mobilizing the community to actively preserve the ecosystem through education and awareness on sustainable living and water management practices. Additionally, targeted training programs will be facilitated for sector partners to equip them with modern restoration techniques, natural resource management strategies, and community engagement approaches for long-term sustainability.
The overall objective of this project is to incorporate multifaceted and transformative approach in the Aravalli Green Wall Project. The key objectives of the project are:
• Develop a comprehensive eco-restoration plan in a pilot area with a focus on restoring biodiversity and water balance to enhance the quality of life and promote sustainable urban development in the area.
• Mobilise the community to preserve the ecosystem and promote nature education and awareness about sustainable water management practices sustainable living.
• Facilitate targeted training programmes for sector partners focusing on modern restoration techniques, natural resource management practices, blue green infrastructures in urban spaces, sustainable forest and wildlife management practices, and community engagement strategies.
